texts.en: This species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage available. Now, their hunger leads them to the stars.

sections.zh:
[GetSpeciesNamePlural]永远都是猎人。我们无时无刻不在寻找猎物，不惜深入最危险的环境也要狩猎最奇异的生命。只要猎物能够转化成你的血肉，努力就永远不会白费。

我们一直清楚，是猎物的血肉塑造了我们自己——每次狩猎、杀戮都让我们更上一层楼。

我们暴戾的历史并不是包袱，而是我们族群的精华所在。在现代科技的加持下，我们的进化再也不需要茹毛饮血；仅需痕量的基因物质之丝缕，就足以编入我们的织构。

对演化的渴望在我们的体内熊熊燃烧，在[GetStartingDrive]带来的黎明中，我们已经做好准备潜入星系这片狩猎场，收获其中所有的一切。
sections.en:
The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. We seek prey wherever we can find it, braving even the most extreme environments to taste something new. When you are what you eat, the effort is never in vain.

We have always known that we are shaped by the flesh of our quarry - each hunt, every kill, has made us stronger.

Our violent past is not a burden but the essence of our being. Refined through the lens of modern science, we no longer need to feast to evolve; a mere trace of genetic material is enough to weave its strength into our own.

The hunger for evolution burns within us still, and with the dawn of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to stalk the galaxy to savor all it has to offer.

sections.zh:
[GetSpeciesNamePlural]永远都是猎人。我们无时无刻不在寻找猎物，不惜深入最危险的环境也要狩猎最奇异的生命。只要猎物能够转化成你的血肉，努力就永远不会白费。

我们的集体潜意识一直知道自己的基因潜能——我们可以吸收并适应猎物的特性，将它们的优势整合到我们的集体中。

这种古老的捕食本能延续至今达到了一种受控平衡。我们不再需要依赖狩猎来进化，而是可以在实验室内合成任何遗传物质并将其无缝地分发到整个蜂巢中。

随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们已经做好了准备踏遍星系，收获其中的一切。
sections.en:
The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. We seek prey wherever we can find it, braving even the most extreme environments to taste something new. When you are what you eat, the effort is never in vain.

Our shared intelligence implicitly has always understood the potential of our genetics - we can absorb and adapt the essence of our quarry, integrating their strengths into our collective.

That ancient predatory instinct still lingers, but now it is balanced and controlled. No longer must we hunt to evolve; our labs can synthesize any genetic material and seamlessly distribute it throughout our hive.

With the advent of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to spread across the galaxy and savor all it has to offer.

sections.zh:
[GetSpeciesNamePlural]永远都是猎人。我们无时无刻不在寻找猎物，不惜深入最危险的环境也要狩猎最奇异的生命。只要猎物能够转化成你的血肉，努力就永远不会白费。

直到吞噬了[GetHomeWorldName]上的一切生命形式后我们才意识到了自己的愚蠢。这下我们得上哪儿去找到新的适应力？于是我们抬起了头。

一般的猎食者为了生存狩猎，而我们作为完美的猎食者，狩猎是为了达到我们自身的完美。

随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们又一次做好了屏息凝神的准备。星系无边无垠，宛如一场饕餮盛宴。
sections.en:
The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. We seek prey wherever we can find it, braving even the most extreme environments to taste something new. When you are what you eat, the effort is never in vain.

Only after we had consumed every last lifeform on [GetHomeWorldName] did we realize our folly. How would we get new adaptations now? So we looked up.

We are the ultimate predators. Others hunt to survive; we hunt to perfect ourselves.

With the advent of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to prowl once more. The galaxy is vast, and full of food.

sections.zh:
[GetSpeciesNamePlural]生来便是猎手。浩瀚虚空也不过是我们追猎过的最深邃的荒野——而方舟就是我们生长出的最锋利的獠牙。在饥饿的驱使下，没有我们无法穿透的黑暗，也没有遥不可及的距离。

我们深知，猎物的血肉塑造了我们——每次狩猎、杀戮，都让我们更上一层楼。

我们暴戾的历史并不是包袱，而是我们族群的精华所在。在现代科技的加持下，我们的进化再也不需要茹毛饮血；仅需痕量的基因物质之丝缕，就足以编入我们的织构。

对演化的渴望在我们的体内熊熊燃烧，随着[GetStartingDrive]的部署，我们已准备巡视星海，收获其中所有的一切。
sections.en:
The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. The void is simply the deepest wilderness we have ever stalked - and our arkship, the sharpest fang we have ever grown. No darkness too complete, no distance too great, when hunger drives us forward.

We have always known that we are shaped by the flesh of our quarry - each hunt, every kill, has made us stronger.

Our violent past is not a burden but the essence of our being. Refined through the lens of modern science, we no longer need to feast to evolve; a mere trace of genetic material is enough to weave its strength into our own.

The hunger for evolution burns within us still, and with the fleet-wide installation of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to stalk the galaxy to savor all it has to offer.

texts.zh:
为了加速进化，我们必须果断地选择出一条进行自我定义的道路。当开始意识到自己全部的潜力时，我们敏锐地意识到，这种努力可能从根本上改变我们的本质。

设计进化是一项意义深远的任务。如今的变革亦将重塑我们的未来。
texts.en:
To expedite our evolution, we must decisively select the path that will define our journey. As we begin to realize our full potential, we are acutely aware that this endeavor could fundamentally alter our very essence.

Engineering evolution is a task of profound significance. The alterations we implement now will reshape our future.

texts.zh:
为了加速进化，我们必须果断地选择出一条进行自我定义的道路。当开始意识到自己全部的潜力时，我们敏锐地意识到，这种努力可能从根本上改变我们的本质。

设计进化是一项意义深远的任务。如今的变革亦将重塑我们的未来。

为了开始自我的提升，现在必须选择旅程的第一步要踏向何方。
texts.en:
To expedite our evolution, we must decisively select the path that will define our journey. As we begin to realize our full potential, we are acutely aware that this endeavor could fundamentally alter our very essence.

Engineering evolution is a task of profound significance. The alterations we implement now will reshape our future.

To begin uplifting ourselves, we must now choose on which path we will begin our journey.

texts.zh:
设计进化是一项意义深远的任务。我们现在拥有对基因特质、繁衍和基因测序的更深层次理解。

我们进步的顶峰近在眼前。在短短几年内，我们将充分实现自身作为一个物种的全部潜力。
texts.en:
Engineering our own evolution has led to profound advancements. We now possess a deeper understanding of genetic traits, reproduction, and DNA sequencing.

The culmination of our progress is within reach. In just a few years we will fully realize our potential as a species.

texts.zh:
设计进化是一项意义深远的任务。我们现在拥有对基因特质、繁衍和基因测序的更深层次理解。

我们进步的顶峰近在眼前。在短短几年内，我们将充分实现自身作为一个物种的全部潜力。

然而在目前，我们还会继续在当前道路上前进，或为我们下一个发展阶段改变焦点。
texts.en:
Engineering our own evolution has led to profound advancements. We now possess a deeper understanding of genetic traits, reproduction, and DNA sequencing.

The culmination of our progress is within reach. In just a few years we will fully realize our potential as a species.

At the present however, we may continue on our current path, or choose another focus for the next stage of our development.

texts.zh: 我们的努力把自己推到了一个重大变革的前夕。我们很快就必须对前进道路做出关键决定，从而充分实现我们的进化潜力。
texts.en: Our efforts have led us to the brink of a significant evolutionary shift. Soon, we must make a crucial decision regarding the path we will take to fully realize our evolutionary potential.

texts.zh:
我们的努力把自己推到了一个重大变革的前夕。我们很快就必须对前进道路做出关键决定，从而充分实现我们的进化潜力。

需要再次重新确定着力点了。
texts.en:
Our efforts have led us to the brink of a significant evolutionary shift. Soon, we must make a crucial decision regarding the path we will take to fully realize our evolutionary potential.

We must once again decide where we should focus our efforts.

label.zh: 变异会将我们带向未来。
label.en: Mutation will lead us to the future.

texts.zh: 无论我们是为追求最纯粹的自我而奋斗，还是以克隆铺就成功之路，抑或是通过有意的基因突变来增强自我，此刻过后我们都将为自己的选择一往无前。
texts.en: Whether we strive for the purest form of ourselves, clone our way to success, or genetically augment ourselves through deliberate mutation, this moment marks a point of no return.

texts.zh:
我们的本质始终是可塑的。我们是宇宙中最复杂的生命形式，借助我们的研究，我们将不断改变。

未来是混沌的，而这正是我们所需要的。
texts.en:
Our nature has always been malleable. We are the most complex lifeform in this universe, and with the help of our research we shall keep changing.

The future is chaotic, and that is perfect for us.

label.zh: 我们将深察纯净之真谛。
label.en: We will know what it means to be pure.

label.zh: 我们会以克隆通向成功。
label.en: We will clone ourselves to success.

label.zh: 我们将驾驭变异的力量。

texts.zh: [owner.GetGovernmentName]正在发生转变。我们即将实现自身的全部潜能，同时也意识到这个努力可能从根本上改变我们的本质。设计我们自身的进化是一项意义深远的任务。我们现在实施的改变将会在未来产生深远的影响。
texts.en: The [owner.GetGovernmentName] is transforming. We are about to realize our full potential, aware that this endeavor could fundamentally alter our essence. Engineering our own evolution is a task of profound significance. The changes we implement now will ripple far into the future.

texts.zh:
[owner.GetGovernmentName]正在发生转变。我们即将实现自身的全部潜能，同时也意识到这个努力可能从根本上改变我们的本质。设计我们自身的进化是一项意义深远的任务。我们现在实施的改变将会在未来产生深远的影响。

我们现在必须为进化的第一阶段选择一个发展重点。
texts.en:
The [owner.GetGovernmentName] is transforming. We are about to realize our full potential, aware that this endeavor could fundamentally alter our essence. Engineering our own evolution is a task of profound significance. The changes we implement now will ripple far into the future.

We must now choose a focus for the first stage of our development.

texts.zh:
设计我们自身的进化已经带来了显著的改变。我们现在对基因特征、繁殖过程和DNA序列有了更深入的理解。

我们的工作即将达到顶峰。

不久之后，我们将成为注定要成为的样子。
texts.en:
Engineering our own evolution has led to significant change. We now possess a deeper understanding of genetic traits, reproduction, and DNA sequencing.

The culmination of our work is within reach.

Soon, we will become what we were always meant to be.

texts.zh:
设计我们自身的进化已经带来了显著的改变。我们现在对基因特征、繁殖过程和DNA序列有了更深入的理解。

我们的工作即将达到顶峰。

不久之后，我们将成为注定要成为的样子。我们有机会选择继续沿当前道路前进，或选择新的焦点。
texts.en:
Engineering our own evolution has led to significant change. We now possess a deeper understanding of genetic traits, reproduction, and DNA sequencing.

The culmination of our work is within reach.

Soon, we will become what we were always meant to be. We have an opportunity to continue on our current path, or choose a new focus.

texts.zh: 我们正处在一个重大演化突破的边缘。我们很快就要为充分发挥演化潜力而面临关键的抉择。
texts.en: We are on the brink of a significant evolutionary breakthrough. Soon, we must make a crucial decision regarding the path we will take to fully realize our evolutionary potential.

texts.zh:
我们正处在一个重大演化突破的边缘。我们很快就要为充分发挥演化潜力而面临关键的抉择。

我们必须再一次选择优先事项。
texts.en:
We are on the brink of a significant evolutionary breakthrough. Soon, we must make a crucial decision regarding the path we will take to fully realize our evolutionary potential.

Once more, we must choose where our priorities lie.

label.zh: 变异会将我们带向未来。
label.en: Mutation will lead us to the future.

texts.zh: 无论我们是追求最纯粹的自我形态，还是通过克隆技术走向成功，抑或是通过刻意突变来进行基因增强，这一刻都标志着一个不可回头的转折点。
texts.en: Whether we strive for the purest form of ourselves, clone our way to success, or genetically augment ourselves through deliberate mutation, this moment marks a point of no return.

texts.zh:
我们的本质始终是可塑的。我们是宇宙中最复杂的生命形式，借助我们的研究，我们将不断改变。

未来是混沌的，而这正是我们所需要的。
texts.en:
Our nature has always been malleable. We are the most complex lifeform in this universe, and with the help of our research we shall keep changing.

The future is chaotic, and that is perfect for us.

label.zh: 我们将深察纯净之真谛。
label.en: We will know what it means to be pure.

label.zh: 我们会以克隆通向成功。
label.en: We will clone ourselves to success.

label.zh: 我们将驾驭变异的力量。

texts.zh:
我们的物种正站在下一个宏伟前沿的边缘。我们现在必须做出选择。

我们是要拥抱我们的命运，净化我们的基因谱系，将我们的文明提升到基因卓越的新高度？还是要保留我们过去的教训，以当前未经提炼的形态继续前进？
texts.en:
Our species stands on the edge of its next grand frontier. We must now make a choice.

Will we embrace our destiny, purifying our genetic lineage to elevate our civilization to new heights of genetic excellence? Or will we retain the lessons of our past and continue in our current, unrefined form?

label.en: Embrace purity and advance to new heights!

label.zh: 我们无需改变自我管理的方式。
label.en: We need not change the ways we govern ourselves.

texts.zh:
我们的物种已经到达关键时刻。必须做出决定。

我们是要拥抱命运，驾驭克隆的力量，不可逆转地将自身转变为一个复制完美的文明？还是要吸收迄今为止旅程的教训，继续保持我们不必要的差异化？
texts.en:
Our species has arrived at a crucial moment. A decision must be made.

Shall we embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of cloning, irrevocably transforming ourselves into a civilization of replicated perfection? Or shall we absorb the lessons of our journey so far and persist in our needless differentiation?

label.zh: 我们将克隆作为未来的重要组成部分。
label.en: We embrace cloning as a vital part of our future.

label.zh: 我们无需改变自我管理的方式。
label.en: We need not change the ways we govern ourselves.

texts.zh:
我们正处在关键生物前沿的风口浪尖。一个重要的抉择在等待着我们。

我们可以通过驾驭高级生物突变的力量来拥抱我们的命运，通过对我们基因密码的刻意进化来不可逆转地改变我们的文明。或者我们可以保留从过去探索中获得的教训，继续保持我们当前平凡的形态。
texts.en:
We are on the cusp of a pivotal biological frontier. An important choice awaits.

We can either embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of advanced biological mutation, irrevocably transforming our civilization through the deliberate evolution of our genetic code. Or we can preserve the lessons gained from our past exploits and continue in our current, mundane form.

label.zh: 我们可以成为任何和一切。
label.en: We can be anything and everything.

label.zh: 我们无需改变自我管理的方式。
label.en: We need not change the ways we govern ourselves.

label.en: We can be anything and everything.

label.zh: 我们无需改变自我管理的方式。
label.en: We need not change the ways we govern ourselves.

texts.zh:
我们物种演化得愈发复杂。在群星之间寻得新的基因物质之后，我们已经准备好吸纳其中的一个部分。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]们的辛勤劳动给我们带来了一些的选择。

无论做任何决定都将会影响到[Owner.GetSpeciesName]的子子孙孙们的未来。
texts.en:
Our species grows more complex. After scouring the stars for new genetic material, we are ready to adopt a new aspect. Thanks to the hard work of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] we have a choice.

Whatever decision we make will affect the future of the [Owner.GetSpeciesName] for generations to come.

label.zh: 我们的物种需要成长得更快！
label.en: Our species needs to grow faster!
Can we be made more productive?

label.zh: 我们的领袖需要各种优势。
我们需要适应变化的气候。
label.en: We need to adapt to shifting climates.

label.zh: 降低我们人口所需要的维护费。
label.en: Reduce the upkeep required to sustain our people.

label.zh: 类人物种特质可以增强我们的适应力。
label.en: Humanoid traits could enhance our versatility.

label.zh: 哺乳类基因藏着更多秘密。
鸟类可以让我们无比轻盈。
label.en: Avians could grant us unmatched agility.
Even a molluscoid can teach us something.

label.zh: 真菌类扩张迅速——我们也可以。
label.en: Fungoids spread rapidly - we could too.

label.zh: 植物类的能量效率大有裨益。
label.en: The energy efficiency of the plantoids could be useful.

label.zh: 石质类基因难以下咽，但也存在可口的可能性。
label.en: Difficult to consume, lithoid DNA offers delicious possibilities.

label.zh: 死灵类的肉体也还是肉体。
水生类的适应力能在大海之外也带来生存策略。
label.en: Aquatic adaptations offer survival strategies beyond the sea.

label.zh: 嗜热者会燃烧，但我们能处理好。
label.en: The Thermophiles burn, but now we can handle it.

label.zh: 稳定等离子体基因将会是一场饕餮盛宴。
label.en: Stabilizing Plasmic DNA would be an impressive feat.

label.zh: 灵能基因组中究竟是什么激发了这样的超凡认知力？
label.en: What within the Psionic genome fuels such cognitive prowess?

label.zh: 星系中的巨物们能教会我们些什么呢？
label.en: What can the Titans of the galaxy teach us?

label.zh: 拥抱混沌——让直觉指引我们！
label.en: Embrace the chaos - let our instincts guide us!

label.zh: 让变异产生的能力带我们突破自然的限制。
label.en: Let mutation unlock abilities beyond our natural limitations!

texts.zh: 我们的特工正在[Target.GetSpeciesName]定居点潜行，很快将能进入他们的建筑。我们需要耐心，而我们有的是耐心——最好的猎手总是从容不迫的。
texts.en: Our operatives are prowling [Target.GetSpeciesName] settlements and will soon gain access to their structures. All in good time. We are a patient breed; the best hunts are never rushed.

texts.zh: 猎物就在眼前。我们派遣去渗透[Target.GetName]的猎手非常有信心。他们将很快能进入[Target.GetSpeciesName]的居住区，宝贵的基因物质触手可及。
texts.en: Our prey is in sight. The hunters we sent to infiltrate the [Target.GetName] are confident. They will soon have access to the [Target.GetSpeciesName] dormitory, and all of the precious DNA within.

texts.zh: 我们的特工已经准备就绪。他们已经获得了进入[Target.GetSpeciesName]集居地的权限，并且准备好了合适的伪装。当然，像任何优秀的猎手一样，他们已经确保了多条撤离路线，有些比较体面，有些则不太体面。如果不得不使用下水道逃生，那可就太不幸了。
texts.en: Our agents are ready. They have gained access to the [Target.GetSpeciesName] dormitory as well as proper disguises. Naturally, like any good hunter, they have secured multiple escape routes, some more agreeable than others. It will be unfortunate should we need to make use of the sewers.

texts.zh: 成功了！我们的特工带着一大堆基因物质满载而归，这样一来在下一次突变时我们又能确保获取巨大的优势了。也许我们还可以发展出对[From.Target.GetSpeciesName]的一些口味偏好。
texts.en: It is done! Our operatives have come away with a wealth of genetic material. We are sure to see great advancements when next we mutate. Perhaps we might even develop a taste for the [From.Target.GetSpeciesName].

texts.zh: 我们伟大的[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]为国鞠躬尽瘁，享年[From.GetAge]岁。人们高呼，为了纪念这位领袖对[Root.GetName]的贡献，要举办一场盛大的追思仪式。这一盛事能将民众团结在一起，巩固我们的理念。
texts.en: Our great [From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] has passed away at the age of [From.GetAge] while in service to our empire. The people clamor for a memorial service to honor this leader's contribution to the [Root.GetName]. A grand event will give everyone closure, and bolster our ideals.

label.zh: 一场私人葬礼就足够了。

label.en: [From.GetHeSheCap] did nothing to deserve such honors.

label.zh: 规划一场盛大的追悼游行。马上。
以[From.GetHisHer]的名义设立一个基金。
label.en: Set up a foundation in [From.GetHisHer] name.

label.zh: 建立一座适合的纪念碑。
一场小规模的悼念会就足够了。
以[From.GetHisHer]的名字命名一个地标。

label.en: [From.GetHisHerCap] story does not have to end here...
The [Root.GetRulerTitle] wishes to consume the Honored one.
The [Root.GetRulerTitle] wishes to consume the Honored one.
The [Root.GetRulerTitle] wishes to consume the Honored one.
The [Root.GetRulerTitle] wishes to consume the Honored one.

texts.zh:
在长长的游行队伍中，[From.GetName]静静地沉眠，[Root.GetName]的每一位公民都受邀前来表示敬意。

葬礼之后是为期一周的盛大祭典，祭典花费巨大。[From.GetName]的透明水晶棺材在[Root.Capital.GetName]纪念堂展出。人群排在街头，想要一睹他们伟大领袖的最终安息之处。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] has been laid to rest following a public procession. Every citizen of [Root.GetName] was invited to pay their respects.

The funeral is followed by a week-long festival, with no expenses spared. [From.GetName]'s translucent crystal casket is displayed at the [Root.Capital.GetName] memorial site, where the crowds line the streets hoping to catch a glimpse of the great leader in their final resting place.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]在最亲近的亲属和同事的环绕中静静地沉眠。其对[Root.GetName]的贡献不菲，但现在并不是能铺张浪费的时候。
texts.en: [From.GetName] is laid to rest in a private ceremony with their closest family members and colleagues. Their contribution to the [Root.GetName] was an important one, but now is not the time for exorbitant expenditure.

texts.zh: 我们对[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]的谨慎处置被媒体迅速捕捉到了。尽管一些人表达了担忧，但许多消息来源还是坚定地指出了这位领袖的缺点。当前的普遍看法是，我们终于可以找一位更合适的继任者来替代现在这位领袖了。
texts.en: The discreet disposal of our [From.GetTitle], [From.GetName], has been promptly noted by the press. While others express concern, many sources adamantly point out the leader's shortcomings. The general sentiment is relief that we can now replace this leader with a more fitting successor.

label.en: It is time to move on.

texts.zh:
在一场简短的追悼会后，[From.GetTitle]的遗体被捐赠给了科学界，以对基础医药研究和教育继续做贡献。

这些过程中剩下的东西最终将被水火化，变成富含矿物质的肥料，确保身体的任何部分都不会被浪费。
texts.en:
After a brief commemoration, the [From.GetTitle]'s body has been donated to science to contribute towards essential medical research and education.

What is left from these procedures will in the end be water cremated and turned into a mineral-rich fertilizer, ensuring no part of the body goes to waste.

label.en: Such is the cycle of life.

texts.zh:
人们聚集在一起，追悼[From.GetName]的一生及其丰功伟绩。人们挤满了街道，向东望不见头，向西望不见尾。颂歌一直唱到了夜幕降临。[From.GetHeSheCap]现在已经跨入彼岸。

[From.GetHisHer]的布道节选现在在整个帝国回荡，提醒着我们共同的目标。
texts.en:
The people gathered in their masses to celebrate the life and career of [From.GetName]. Huge processions filled the streets, and hymns were sung long into the night. [From.GetHeSheCap] is now waiting for us on the other side of the veil.

Popular excerpts from [From.GetHisHer] sermons are now reverberating across the empire, reminding us of our common goal.

texts.zh:
大型阅兵方阵和舰队护卫着[From.GetName]的灵柩前往最终安息之地。[From.GetHisHerCap]的遗体被发射去了最近的恒星，并全程向全社会广播。

逝世领袖的个人战略部署和日志成为了下一批军校学员课程中的内容。
texts.en:
A huge parade of troops and a flyover by naval forces marked the arrival of [From.GetName]'s casket to its final resting place. [From.GetHisHerCap] body was fired into the nearest star during a society-wide broadcast.

The departed leader's personal strategies and log books will become a part of the curriculum for the next generation of cadets.

texts.zh: 为了纪念刚刚去世的伟大[From.GetTitle]，[From.GetName]，我们设立了一个非盈利的基金会。这个基金会标志着星际的和平与和谐发展迈出了一步，包容了不同社群和物种之间的分歧。
texts.en: A non-profit foundation has been established to honor the passing of the great [From.GetTitle], [From.GetName]. The foundation marks a step towards peace and interstellar harmony, bridging differences between communities and species.

label.zh: 我们共同创造了一项遗产。

texts.zh:
当[From.GetName]去世的消息传遍更远的地区时，一种深深的悲痛笼罩了整个帝国。无数的哀悼者遵循传统的葬礼仪式加入了[Root.Capital.GetName]的葬礼队伍中。

其遗体被一丝不苟地清洁并进行了适当的装饰。在[From.GetTitle]的遗体进行了安葬之前，我们全国上下都要默哀，表示尊重。
texts.en:
A deep sorrow has gripped the public as news regarding the passing of [From.GetName] spreads to the wider community. Countless mourners join the funeral procession on [Root.Capital.GetName] to follow the traditional funeral rites.

The body is meticulously cleansed and appropriately decorated. Before the deceased [From.GetTitle] is laid to rest, a moment of silence is observed throughout our systems as a mark of respect.

texts.zh:
为纪念[From.GetName]一生的丰功伟绩，我们为[From.GetHimHer]准备了一场穿越星海的最后航行。

一个容纳着[From.GetTitle]遗体的胶囊被庄严地发射向未探索的宇域，伴随他的还有诗歌、图表、录音和其他贵宾带来的随葬品。将来有一天，[From.GetTitle]的船只可能会在那里找到一个新家，完成[From.GetHisHer]的最后任务。
texts.en:
The remarkable deeds of [From.GetName] have warranted [From.GetHimHer] one last voyage through space.

A capsule containing the [From.GetTitle]'s remains is ceremonially launched into the void alongside poems, charts, recordings, and other memorabilia brought by various dignitaries. One day the [From.GetTitle]'s vessel may find a new home out there, completing [From.GetHisHer] final mission.

texts.zh: 工匠们获得最好的材料来制作[From.GetName]的肖像，将其加入到[Root.GetName]传奇英雄的行列中。其庄严的面孔被蚀刻在石头和金属上，让人们牢记这位强大领袖的丰功伟绩。
texts.en: Artisans have been provided with the finest materials to fashion the likeness of [From.GetName], adding them to the long line of storied heroes of the [Root.GetName]. Their majestic visage is etched in stone and metal, acting as a reminder of what strong leaders can accomplish.

label.zh: 您的伟大将被永远铭记。

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的名字与头衔被镌刻在了一座高大耸立的纪念碑上，与无数其他为[Root.GetName]的人民鞠躬尽瘁的人们并列。这位备受尊敬的[From.GetTitle]将被人民永远铭记，他的贡献为未来数代领袖们开拓道路。
texts.en: [From.GetName]'s name and title are carved on a towering monument alongside others who have served the [Root.GetName] for the good of its population. The respected [From.GetTitle] will be fondly remembered by the people, paving the way for future generations of leaders.

label.en: For the good of the many.

texts.zh:
这位领袖的去世引起了星际证交所短暂但剧烈的震荡。

除了举办奢华的葬礼，[Root.GetName]还将一座较高的摩天楼重命名为[From.GetName]大厦以确保以后这位[From.GetTitle]的名字会被写入公司的编年史中。每间会议室的墙上都挂着一幅经过艺术诠释的肖像，以纪念其对帝国的杰出贡献。
texts.en:
News of the leader's passing is met with a sharp, but brief downturn in share value at the galactic stock markets.

In addition to sponsoring the lavish funeral, [Root.GetName] rebrands one of its taller skyscrapers as the [From.GetName] Building to ensure that the late [From.GetTitle]'s name is preserved in the annals of the corporate history. An artistically interpreted portrait is also hung on every boardroom wall to commemorate their outstanding contributions to the empire.

texts.zh:
[From.Species.GetName]的去世并不像表面上看起来那么彻底。尽管躯干已经开始劣化，但核心还可以恢复活力。

在浸泡过一种特殊的激素溶液后，[From.GetName]的遗体被小心翼翼地埋入[burial_planet.GetName]的土壤中。埋葬地由孵化者精心照料，他们耐心地等待幼体破土发芽，开始新的循环。
texts.en:
The death of a [From.Species.GetName] is not as final as it appears. Even if the main stem has begun to deteriorate, the roots can be reinvigorated.

After soaking in a special hormone solution, [From.GetName]'s remains are carefully buried in the soil of [burial_planet.GetName]. The burial site is tended by brood members who patiently await for younglings to sprout on the surface, starting the cycle anew.

label.en: From one life to the next.

texts.zh:
[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]在可靠地服务了[From.GetYearsOfService]后发生了故障，彻底报废。我们的科学家已经备份了文件以保留重要数据。

基于[From.GetName]的智能全息图谱已经被安装在我们的舰船系统中，作为虚拟顾问为我们服务。他们将继续支援我们的任务。
texts.en:
[From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] has broken down after [From.GetYearsOfService] of reliable service. Our scientists have backed up their files to preserve important data.

An intelligent hologram based on [From.GetName] has been installed in our ship systems to serve as a virtual advisor. They will continue to aid in our mission.

label.zh: 死亡不再是一项障碍了。
label.en: Death is no longer an obstacle.

texts.zh: [From.GetTitle][From.GetName]的意识在[From.GetAge]岁时从集体意识中移除。我们是[Root.GetName]，我们将永存。
texts.en: The mind of [From.GetTitle] [From.GetName] was removed from the collective at the age of [From.GetAge]. We are the [Root.GetName]. We will endure.

texts.zh: 自然选择和基因漂变再也不能阻止我们主宰生物学规律。作为一个文明，我们正在重塑物种未来的门槛前。[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]如同黏土，而我们将会是自己的雕刻家。
texts.en: Natural selection and genetic drift no longer stand between us and biological dominance. As a civilization, we are on the verge of redefining the future of our species. Our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] is clay, and we are its sculptor.

texts.zh: 随着不断与新物种遭遇，我们对各种独特的['concept_evopred_genetic_insights']进行分析、传播。一旦完成，我们就可以演化，向我们的基因编码中永久性地增添新的正面物种特质。
texts.en: Unique ['concept_evopred_genetic_insights'] are analyzed and disseminated as we encounter new species. Once finished, we will evolve, permanently adding a new positive Species Trait to our own genetic code.
